notes: The Orc Cave set is a war band's camp: sharpened stakes, skull-crowned standards and their weapon rack. The orc war banners are the Nemesis orc-captain and orc-lord trophies, so the curator takes the other banners and standards. The Pair of War Band Standards is the showpiece.

entries.why: Hide-wrapped standard crowned with a skull.
Skull above a battered round shield.
Wall axe rack of long-hafted axes.
Pair of War Band Standards, a hide and a shield.
